**22 palavras novas** (negociações).

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo ler, ouvir, falar e escrever sobre uma negociadora a partir de uma biografia, usando take on e to challenge an assumption.

body: Esta aula treina **responder em frases completas (IELTS Speaking, TOEFL Speaking)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.name: Maria Santos Reyes
paras: Maria Santos Reyes (fictional) built her career as a trade mediator in Manila. In 2008 she **took on** a dispute between fishing cooperatives and a canning company that no one else wanted. Instead of defending either side, she began **to challenge an assumption** both held: that one group’s gain must be the other’s loss.
By 2012, her model of shared quotas had been adopted by five regions. Colleagues say she **took on** hard cases because she believed trust could be rebuilt.

items.q: She challenged the idea that gains must be zero-sum.
Her model was adopted by five regions.

blocks.body: Em biografias, verbos de ação no **passado simples** contam a trajetória; o **past perfect** marca o que veio antes.

items.s: In 2008 she ___ on a difficult dispute. (take, past)
She wanted to challenge an ___ both sides held. (assumption)
By 2012 her model ___ adopted. (have been, past perfect)
She believed trust could be ___ . (rebuild, particípio)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: Why did you take on that dispute
items.pt: Por que você assumiu aquela disputa?

body: **to challenge an assumption** — questionar uma premissa
**Break the mold.** — Quebrar o molde.
**Stand one’s ground.** — Manter sua posição.
**Against all odds.** — Contra todas as probabilidades.
**Rise to the occasion.** — Estar à altura.
**Common ground.** — Terreno comum.
**Bring both sides together.** — Aproximar os dois lados.
**A tough nut to crack.** — Um osso duro de roer.
**Make her mark.** — Deixar sua marca.
**Why did you take on that dispute?** — Por que você assumiu aquela disputa?
**What was the assumption?** — Qual era a premissa?
**Nobody else would, and both sides held a false assumption.** — Ninguém mais assumiria, e os dois lados tinham uma premissa falsa.

items.label: Expressividade
items.note: Expressividade: varie altura e velocidade para mostrar atitude (firmeza, cautela, cortesia) sem mudar as palavras.

prompts.q: Tell about a challenge you took on.
prompts.model: Last year I took on a difficult project.

prompts.q: Challenge an assumption you hear often.
prompts.model: People assume bigger teams are better; I’d challenge that.

prompts.q: Ask a guest why she did something.
prompts.model: Why did you take on that case?

blocks.task: Write a 6-sentence mini-biography of a real or fictional mediator.
blocks.model: Lena Okoye was a mediator in Lagos. In 2015 she took on a long dispute between two market associations. She challenged the assumption that only one side could win. Her shared-stall plan was adopted by six markets. Colleagues remember her patience. She believed every conflict hides a common interest.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
